title: Community Laptop Repair Corner for Devices That Are Almost Usable Again
description: Many donated laptops and small electronics are one charging cable, one replacement battery, or one cleanup session away from being useful again. This project funds a weekend repair corner with tool kits, thermal paste, replacement screws, anti-static mats, and a few common spare parts so volunteers can test, repair, and prepare devices for reuse instead of sending them straight into e-waste. We want to reduce electronics waste while also giving students and families access to refurbished devices that still have years of life left.
